name: Chip lithography machines
one_line: Builds the machines that print circuit patterns onto silicon with light. Every advanced chip passes under one.
sells: Lithography scanners (EUV and DUV) plus service contracts
suppliers: Precision optics, lasers, light sources, ultra-pure parts

revenue.note: Market-research estimate (GMI). ASML's own revenue (€32.7B in 2025) is larger because it also counts service and other tools.

structure.why: Only one company can build EUV machines, the ones needed for the most advanced chips. Rivals compete only in older, cheaper machines.
structure.hhi_note: Lower bound, from ASML's share alone.

econ: Monopoly from a technology no rival can copy: decades of R&D and a global supplier network built up since the 1990s act as the barrier to entry.

companies.name: Canon
companies.note: Older-generation and packaging lithography; with Nikon holds most of the remaining ~12%.

companies.name: SMEE
companies.note: China's domestic lithography maker; no reliable share figure found.
